<!--
  The order history as a table or as cards: number, date, items, total and a status pill, with an optional
  pager. Axes: layout (table, cards), pager (show, hide), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Order, OrderLabels } from "./order-table.types";

export type OrderTableProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  orders: Order[];
  statuses: Record<string, string>;
  labels: OrderLabels;
  layout?: "table" | "cards";
  pager?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Card from "../primitives/card/card.vue";
import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import OrderRows from "../components/order-rows.vue";
import Pager from "../components/pager.vue";
import Pill from "../components/pill.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { at, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  orders,
  statuses,
  labels,
  layout = "table",
  pager = "show",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<OrderTableProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density">
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
      <OrderRows
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'table')"
        :orders="orders"
        :statuses="statuses"
        :labels="labels"
        :density="density"
      />
      <Stack v-else gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="order-cards">
        <Card v-for="o in orders" :key="o.id" variant="default" data-testid="item">
          <CardContent class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {{ o.number }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ o.date }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <Text size="sm">
              {{ tpl(labels.itemsCount, o.items) }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" weight="bold">
              {{ fmtMoney(o.total, o.currency) }}
            </Text>
            <Pill
              :tone="
                o.status === 'paid' ? 'green'
                : o.status === 'shipped' ? 'blue'
                : o.status === 'pending' ? 'amber'
                : 'gray'
              "
            >
              {{ at(statuses, o.status) }}
            </Pill>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </Stack>
      <Pager v-if="((pager as string) === 'show')"
        :page="1"
        :pages="3"
        :summary="tpl(labels.summary, 1, 4, 12)"
        :previousLabel="labels.previous"
        :nextLabel="labels.next"
      />
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
